posts.title: Slow inefficient (non-derogatory) guestbook
posts.description: I made a guestbook , like we used to have in the old days, except this one has a physical component. It’s pretty inefficient and impractical, and I love it. My soul has been yearning to decouple the <making of a Thing> from <being productive> and to rediscover the joy of making things that are not really necessary but just fun.
